agent: reader C of the trade and aid wave (2026-10-13): aid - debt, licences, lend-lease, shared technology
question: Each kind of aid as the original computes it: CDebtAction, CLicenceTechnologyAction, CRequestLendLeaseAction and COfferLendLeaseAction arm by arm; debt growth and repayment; the licence fee and what a licence builds; the lend-lease share's distribution, what a recipient receives, the neutrality limit and the IC caps, the lend-lease convoy; shared technology; slots 11, 12, 13, 14 and 18 and the messages.

addresses.name: CDebtAction::Apply
addresses.comment:
CDebtAction slot 7, one holder (vftable 0x15FB9F4). 0xA3D8A0 to the bare `ret` at 0xA3E500, 15 int3, then slot 11 at 0xA3E510; the earlier `ret`s are arms of the same frame. `this` in ECX. **Read arm by arm, 2026-10-13.** `allowDebts` on `X->diplomacy[Y]` means *X may go into debt with Y* - so the asker of 'Allow Debt' is the would-be debtor.

| arm | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| PROPOSE, value 1 (ask) | `actor->diplo_influence -= ALLOW_DEBT_INFLUENCE_COST` (diplomacy +0xC4), floored at 0 (0xA3DF85..) - charged on the offer, never refunded |
| PROPOSE, value 0 (revoke) | `recipient->diplomacy[actor]->allowDebts = 0` (0xA3DD48) - the revoker is the creditor, the recipient the debtor - and then **`recipient->diplo_influence -= REVOKE_DEBT_INFLUENCE_COST`** (+0xC8), floored at 0 (0xA3DD77): the debtor pays for being cut off, although IsSelectable demands the cost of the revoker; the recipient, if played, is told DEBTREVOKE at its acting capital. No answer is asked (slot 18 is `value`) |
| ACCEPT | with `value`: `actor->diplomacy[recipient]->allowDebts = 1` (0xA3E012); the actor, if played, hears `diplomaticsuccess` and is told DEBTALLOWACCEPT |
| DECLINE | the actor, if played, hears `diplomaticfailure` and is told DEBTALLOWDECLINE |

Nothing here touches the debt itself (+0x70): revoking leaves an existing debt in place, and it is repaid as before (CCountry::CollectDailyProduction). No message to a third country. The name `Apply` is ours.
addresses.evidence: Ghidra decompilation of 0xA3D8A0 and disassembly of the writes at 0xA3DD48 (esi = [esp+0x60] = this, `[ecx+0x78]` where ecx = countries[[edi+0x14]]->+0xE28[[esi+0xC]]), the influence write at 0xA3DD77 (`[edi+0x14]`, edi = this, reloaded at 0xA3DB5B), 0xA3DF85 (actor) and 0xA3E012. Wrong if edi were not `this` at 0xA3DD23 - the only writes to edi in 0xA3D8A0..0xA3DD23 are at 0xA3D8CB, 0xA3D9B2, 0xA3DA26, 0xA3DAA5 and 0xA3DB5B, the last restoring this.

addresses.name: CDebtAction::GetDialogText
addresses.comment: Slot 12 of CDebtAction - the standard dialog's Description. Revoking: REVOKEDEBTNEWDESC with NAME = the recipient's name and COST = REVOKE_DEBT_INFLUENCE_COST (+0xC8) to 0 places. Allowing: ALLOWDEBTNEWDESC with **NAME = the localised name of the recipient's faction** (CCountry +0xD8, its GetLocalisedName slot), not the country - the text reads 'accumulate debt when trading with the $NAME$' - YEAR = YEARS_TO_REPAY_DEBT (+0xCC) to 0 places, and COST = ALLOW_DEBT_INFLUENCE_COST (+0xC4) to 0 places. `ret 4` at 0xA3F2B6.
addresses.evidence: Ghidra decompilation of 0xA3ECE0 and the define reads at 0xA3EE3C (+0xCC) and 0xA3EEF9 (+0xC4); vtable.py --holding 0xA3ECE0 gives one holder, CDebtAction slot 12. Wrong if the faction call were the country's own name getter - the call goes through CCountry +0xD8's vftable.

addresses.name: CDiplomacyStatus::GetDailyRepay
addresses.comment: **What a debtor repays a day.** Where debt (+0x70) > 0 and daily_repay (+0x74) <= 0 it fixes daily_repay = debt * 1000 / (YEARS_TO_REPAY_DEBT * 365000 / 1000) - the define in thousandths of years made thousandths of days, 50 years being 18,250.000 days - or -1 where that day count is 0; otherwise it keeps what is there. Writes daily_repay into out and returns out. So the figure is fixed once and recomputed only after something sets it to 0, and with Their Finest Hour's 50 years a debt under 18.250 repays 0 a day, which leaves it unpaid for ever. The status in EDI, `ret 4`. One caller, CCountry::CollectDailyProduction at 0x4F2505. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0xA4A7F0..0xA4A8AF: `cmp [edi+0x70],0; jle`, `cmp [edi+0x74],0; jg`, the define read at 0xA4A818 (diplomacy +0xCC, matched by definesMap), `push 0x591C8` (365000) into 0xB99AF0 and `push 0x3E8` into 0xB99980, the -1 arm at 0xA4A841, the divide at 0xA4A86C, stores to [edi+0x74]. findRefs --callers: one, 0x4F2505. Wrong if EDI at the call were not a CDiplomacyStatus - it is `[ebx+0xE28][other id]` at 0x4F24FE.

addresses.name: CCountry::CollectDailyProduction
addresses.comment:
**Where a day's resources go.** Zeroes home_produced and total_produced, adds the base income of metal, energy and rare materials (BaseResourceIncome) to home_produced and the stockpile, then for every province the country controls and each of the five goods that are not supplies or fuel takes CMapProvince::ResourceYield. **Home** - the province's area is the capital's, or its supply depot is a province of the capital's area: the yield goes to the stockpile, home_produced and total_produced. **Cut off** - neither: it goes into the province's own pool and total_produced, and then everything that pool holds of the five goods is moved (CGoodsPool::TakeResources) to the pool of the area's loading port - the start of the first convoy starting in the area that is the country's and trade, lend-lease or without supplies and fuel, else the area's first port - where there is one and it is another province. A subject then calls 0x4F25E0 (not read). Called from RunCountryDailyPass at 0x4DB434. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplyconvoys.md, section 8.

**The loop at the end is debt repayment** (0x4F23E2..0x4F25B9, read 2026-10-13): for every country O in the game state's list, r = CDiplomacyStatus::GetDailyRepay(country->diplomacy[O]). Where r > 0: if the country is at war with anybody (+0xACC), or its pool's money is not **greater** than r, `country->diplomacy[O]->daily_repay = 0` and nothing is paid (so it is worked out afresh on a later day); otherwise its pool's money -= r, O's pool's money += r (each pool chosen as GetPool does, the exile pool or the acting capital's), **`country->repaid_away.money (+0x834) += r` and `O->income_from_debt.money (+0x858) += r`**. The debt (+0x70) is **not** reduced: nothing in the image subtracts from it, so repayment never ends. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-tradeaid.md.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x4F24E6..0x4F25B9: the GetDailyRepay call at 0x4F2505 on `[ebx+0xE28][O->+0xCA8]`, the war test at 0x4F2515, the strict money test `cmp [eax+0x10],edi; jle` at 0x4F253F, the four adds at 0x4F2563, 0x4F2586, 0x4F2589, 0x4F258F, and the reset at 0x4F25B2. The negative on reducing the debt: every `sub`/`add`/`mov` to `[reg+0x70]` in a full .text sweep (2,755,112 instructions) whose register came from a `+0xE28` element - two `add`s in RunDailyTradeRoutes and one in CLicenceTechnologyAction::Apply, no `sub` at all; positive control, the same scan finds the licence's known `add` at 0xA3C5A1. Wrong if the debt were reduced through a register the scan could not tie to the diplomacy array.

addresses.name: CLicenceTechnologyAction::Apply
addresses.comment:
CLicenceTechnologyAction slot 7, one holder (vftable 0x15FB994). **A trap 2 case: 0xA3B5A0 to the bare `ret` at 0xA3CD5D, with only two int3 before slot 11 at 0xA3CD60.** `this` in ECX. Fields (luabind): Subunit +0x28 (CSubUnitDefinition*), Serial +0x2C, Paralell +0x30, Money +0x34. **Read whole 2026-10-13**; the actor is the buyer, the recipient the seller.

1. Message variables ACTOR, RECIPIENT, MESSENGER (= MESSAGE_HEAD_CHAN). NAME = the name of the model the **seller** would build of the type today (CHistoricalModel::PickBestModel over the seller's historical_models[type->+0x24], scored against a CHistoricalModelSet::MakeSubUnit throwaway), with '+*' where that differs from the model the seller's throwaway already matches (FindModelOf); the type's own name where no model. NUM = Serial * Paralell.
2. **onDebt = buyer->diplomacy[seller]->allowDebts && buyer is at war (+0xACC)** (0xA3C213..0xA3C24A).
3. **fee = Money * Serial * Paralell**, thousandths of money: Serial and Paralell are whole counts made thousandths by `floor((n + 0.0005) * 1000)` and each step is a 64-bit `* x / 1000` through 0xB99980, truncating (0xA3C252..0xA3C2F5).
4. ACCEPT and not onDebt and the buyer's money < fee: **the action is turned into a DECLINE** (`type = 1`, 0xA3C348).
5. PROPOSE with value: `buyer->diplo_influence -= LICENCE_INFLUENCE_COST` (+0xB8), floored at 0.
6. ACCEPT with value: a list of one node holding the Subunit; where the session's +0x34 byte is set, **Paralell times** a CConstructUnitCommand (0x84 bytes, constructor 0x545760) is posted to the session channel - the list, the buyer's acting capital (+0xE24), amount = Serial, **is_reserve = the type's +0x2D (land) byte**, build-now 0, country = the buyer, **builder = the seller**, no target. The constructor takes each brigade's technology levels from the builder (CConstructUnitCommand::CConstructUnitCommand), so a licensed unit is built at the seller's levels. Then onDebt: `buyer->diplomacy[seller]->debt (+0x70) += fee` (0xA3C5A1) and the seller is paid nothing now; otherwise buyer's money -= fee and seller's money += fee.
7. Only the buyer, if played, is told: ACCEPT - `diplomaticsuccess`, ACCEPTED = the text of the key ACCEPTED (none in TFH, so the key itself), LICBUYACCEPT; DECLINE - DECLINED likewise, `diplomaticfailure`, LICBUYDECLINE. Both at the seller's acting capital. The name `Apply` is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0xA3C1F0..0xA3C640 (the debt test, the fee arithmetic with the doubles 0.0005 at 0x160A460 and 1000.0 at 0x160A300, the DECLINE rewrite, the influence charge, the CConstructUnitCommand push order 0xA3C4D0..0xA3C541 against the constructor's stores at 0x5457D8..0x545853, the debt add and the two money adds) and the Ghidra decompilation for the message arms. **Corrects the earlier record**, which had the debt as `countries[seller]->diplomacy[buyer]` and the branch byte unexplained: at 0xA3C579..0xA3C5A1 esi = countries[[this+8+4]] (the actor) and edi = [this+0x14] (the recipient). Wrong if `[esp+0x70]` were not &this->actor - it is set from `this+8` at the function head (puStack_138).

addresses.name: CLicenceTechnologyDialog::CLicenceTechnologyDialog
addresses.signature: CLicenceTechnologyDialog* __stdcall CLicenceTechnologyDialog::CLicenceTechnologyDialog(CInGameIdler* host@ECX, CLicenceTechnologyDialog* this@stack:4, CDiplomaticAction* action@stack:8, CDiplomacyView* view@stack:0xC) @EAX
addresses.comment: **The window a production licence is bought in**, `.gui` window `LicenceDialog` (interface/diplomacydialog.gui). Keeps a clone of the action (slot 16) at +0x6C and the view at +0x70; serial (+0x128) and parallel (+0x124) start at 1; the selected type (+0x134) starts as the null sub unit definition. LeftShield / RightShield the actor's and recipient's flags; the title is the action's slot 10; buttons serial_plus/serial_minus/paralell_plus/paralell_minus (0x77BB40/50/60/70: +1/-1 and Refresh); the offered money (+0x12C) from GetOfferedMoney; BuildUnitList; Refresh. `debt_desc` (IS_BOUGHT_WITH_DEBT, 'Debt is used for this deal.') is shown, prefixed with the white escape, only where the buyer may go into debt with the seller and is at war - the same test Apply makes - and hidden otherwise. AgreeButton/DeclineButton read ACCEPT/DECLINE. One caller, DiplomacyView_OpenActionDialog at 0x78BE0B, which passes the in-game screen (view +0xB0) in ECX; `ret 0xC`.
addresses.evidence: Ghidra decompilation of 0x779A00 against the call at 0x78BE02..0x78BE0B (ECX = [edi+0xB0], pushes view, action, object); `ret 0xC` at 0x77A1BD, the vftable 0x15DA38C stored at 0x779A6A; the element names are the .gui file's. Wrong if the debt_desc arm tested a different pair - it reads action +8/+0xC (actor) then `+0xE28[action +0x14]` +0x78 and actor +0xACC.

addresses.name: CLicenceTechnologyDialog::Refresh
addresses.comment: Writes paralell_value and serial_value (decimal); disables paralell_minus/serial_minus at 1 and paralell_plus/serial_plus at 99, so each runs 1..99. Description: BUYLICENCENONE where no type is selected; otherwise BUYLICENCENEWDESC with RUNS = parallel, NUM = serial, TYPE = the type's name and **PAY = money/1000 * parallel * serial as a float to 1 place** - the fee Apply will charge. chance_string = DiplomaticAction_BuildChanceText(action). Then stores parallel, serial and the offered money into the action's Paralell (+0x30), Serial (+0x2C) and Money (+0x34). `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Ghidra decompilation of 0x77A250 and disassembly 0x77AA00..0x77AA77 (the PAY arithmetic: [esi+0x12C]/1000.0 * [esi+0x124] * [esi+0x128]); the four handlers 0x77BB40..0x77BB70 each `inc`/`dec` +0x128 or +0x124 and call this. Wrong if +0x12C were not the money - it is what GetOfferedMoney returns into it in the constructor and in Update.

addresses.name: CLicenceTechnologyDialog::GetOfferedMoney
addresses.comment: **The price per unit offered**: the `money_slider` scrollbar's value as a float, made thousandths by `floor((v + 0.0005) * 1000)`, times the **buyer's money stockpile** (its exile pool, or its acting capital's pool) over 1000. So the slider sets a share of today's cash per unit, and the fee is that times serial times parallel. `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Ghidra decompilation of 0x77BB80 (the slider read through `money_slider`'s +0x48 slot 4, the pool test on +0x95, the 0xB99980 divide by 1000). Wrong if the slider's range were not 0..1 - the .gui file gives none and the scrollbar's own maximum was not read.

addresses.name: CLicenceTechnologyDialog::BuildUnitList
addresses.comment: **Which unit types a licence may be bought for.** Every type of the sub unit database (+0x1C) whose slot 9 answers true, that is buildable (+0x36), usable by the buyer (SubUnitDefinitionIsUsableBy), that the **seller** can still build (CCountry::CountMaxUnitsStillBuildable >= 1), and that is not a capital ship (+0x2F); where the buyer can build it too, only if the buyer's version is worth no more than the seller's (GetSubUnitDefinitionCombatValue of each country's definition made by 0x507500). Each is a CTechMember row of `tech_list`. `ret 4`.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x77B830..0x77B8D6: the tests in order, the buyer ([ebp-0x14]) and seller ([ebp-0x28]) roles from the action's +0xC and +0x14 at the head, the `dec eax; js` that skips the comparison when the buyer cannot build the type, and the `jg` that drops a type whose buyer version scores higher. Wrong if 0x507500 did not build a country's version of the type - it is not recorded and is in the frontier.

addresses.name: LicenceDialogRow_BuildTooltip
addresses.comment: The tooltip of a row of the licence window's `tech_list`, answered from CLicenceTechnologyDialog slot 3 for the element `counter_type`. Where the row's select_frame is disabled (+0x136 clear): BUYLICENCE_MPCOST ('We lack the $COST$ necessary manpower') with COST = the type's build_cost_manpower (+0xFC) times max(1000 + the buyer's build_cost_mp_by_unit_type, one twentieth) / 1000, to 1 place; otherwise the type's name. The delayed half is the **seller's** version of the type (0x507500) through CSubUnitDefinition::BuildStatsTooltip. `ret 8`.
addresses.evidence: Ghidra decompilation of 0x779620; the call from 0x77B400 with the row. Inferred because the meaning of the row's +0x136 byte (disabled) was not read; wrong if it is the selection state.

addresses.name: CLicenceTechnologyDialog::Update
addresses.comment: Slot 1, each frame: refreshes the rows; calls Refresh where the offered money or the action's slot 17 (GetAIAcceptance - so the chance line follows the slider) has changed; disables AgreeButton with no type selected, and **where the buyer's manpower is below the men the order needs** - build_cost_manpower (+0xFC) * max(1000 + build_cost_mp_by_unit_type, one twentieth) / 1000 * serial*parallel - and enables it otherwise. Answers whether the dialog is still open.

addresses.name: CLicenceTechnologyDialog::OnAgree
addresses.comment: Slot 5, the Agree button: the action's date = tick, MakeCommand (slot 6) and post it through the in-game screen's session channel; EnableActionListUnlessAutomated; close (+0x64 = 1). It sets no field of the action itself - Refresh already has.

addresses.comment: Slot 7: true while the view's slot 7 answers true and the view's open dialog (+0x518) is none or this one.

addresses.name: CRequestLendLeaseAction::Apply
addresses.comment:
CRequestLendLeaseAction slot 7, one holder (vftable 0x15FB334). 0xA0ECC0 to the bare `ret` at 0xA0FC57. `this` in ECX. The actor asks; the recipient would give. **Read arm by arm 2026-10-13:**

| arm | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| PROPOSE, value 1 | `actor->diplo_influence -= ALLOW_DEBT_INFLUENCE_COST` (+0xC4), floored at 0 - the debt define, there being no lend-lease one |
| PROPOSE, value 0 (cancel) | CCountry::RemoveLendLease(recipient, actor) (0xA0ED2F); the recipient - the giver - if played is told **LENDOFFERREFUSED**, with ACTOR = its own name and RECIPIENT = the canceller's, at its acting capital |
| ACCEPT, value 1 | CCountry::AddLendLease(giver = recipient, receiver = actor) (0xA0F22C); the actor, if played, hears `diplomaticsuccess` and is told LENDACCEPT |
| DECLINE | the actor, if played, hears `diplomaticfailure` and is told LENDDECLINE |

Nobody else is told anything. The name `Apply` is ours.
addresses.evidence: Ghidra decompilation of 0xA0ECC0 and disassembly of the two calls: 0xA0ED10..0xA0ED2F (ecx = countries[recipient id], pushes the actor's id and tag) and 0xA0F20B..0xA0F22C (eax = countries[[edi+0x14]], pushes [edi+0xC] and [edi+8]). Wrong if the two helpers' roles were reversed - AddLendLease appends to the vector of the country in EAX, the giver's +0x6B8.

addresses.name: COfferLendLeaseAction::Apply
addresses.comment:
COfferLendLeaseAction slot 7, one holder (vftable 0x15FB394). 0xA10870 to the bare `ret` at 0xA11573. `this` in ECX. The actor offers; the recipient would receive. **Read arm by arm 2026-10-13**; reads no define and charges no influence at all.

| arm | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| value 0 and PROPOSE (stop) | CCountry::RemoveLendLease(actor, recipient) (0xA11144); the recipient, if played, is told **LENDREVOKE** with ACTOR = its own name and RECIPIENT = the giver's, at its acting capital. A value-0 action of any other type does nothing |
| value 1, ACCEPT | CCountry::AddLendLease(giver = actor, receiver = recipient) (0xA108DF); the actor, if played, hears `diplomaticsuccess` and is told LENDOFFERACCEPT |
| value 1, DECLINE | the actor, if played, is told LENDOFFERREFUSED |

The name `Apply` is ours.
addresses.evidence: Ghidra decompilation of 0xA10870 and disassembly of the calls at 0xA108B8..0xA108DF (eax = countries[[esi+4]], esi = this+8; pushes the recipient's id and tag) and 0xA1112B..0xA11144. Wrong if the outer test were not `value` - it reads `[this+0x24]` first.

addresses.name: LendLease_GetRoute
addresses.signature: int __cdecl LendLease_GetRoute(CCountryTag* giver@ECX, CCountryTag* receiver@stack:4, Hoi3CString* out@stack:8, bool offerWording@stack:0xC) @EAX
addresses.comment: **Whether lend-lease may run from giver to receiver, and how it travels.** In order, the first that holds: either a government in exile - 0, ACT_LENDLEASE_ANY_GOI (ACTOR = the receiver, RECIPIENT = the giver); the giver's EffectiveNeutrality (+0xA90) above LEND_LEASE_NEUTRALITY_LIMIT (+0x100) - 0, ACT_LENDLEASE_OUR_NEUTRALITY when offerWording else ACT_LENDLEASE_NEUTRALITY, LIMIT and VAL trimmed; the receiver at war with nobody (+0xACC) - 0, ACT_LENDLEASE_THEM_ONLY_AT_WAR / ACT_LENDLEASE_ONLY_AT_WAR; the two at war with each other - 0, WEWAR. Then the route: **2** where the receiver's neighbour byte for the giver is set or the giver is in its ControllerNeighbours list (LEND_LEASE_ALLOWED_NEIGHBOUR); **3** where both capitals' continents have the same tag (LEND_LEASE_ALLOWED_TELEPORT); **1** where both have a naval base (+0xD88 count > 0) (LEND_LEASE_ALLOWED_CONVOY, COUNTRY = the receiver); else 0, LEND_LEASE_NOT_ALLOWED. The text goes to out only where out is not null. The giver's tag in ECX, three stack arguments, bare `ret` - the caller cleans. Callers: 0xA0FEC0, 0xA11790 and CCountry::UpdateLendLeaseRoutes. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0xA10180..0xA105FB with every key named by disasm.py (0xA10200..0xA104BB); the caller 0x508C99 pushes 0, 0, the receiver and sets ECX before `add esp, 0xC`. Wrong if the ECX tag were the receiver - 0xA0FEC0 passes the action's recipient (the asked giver) in ECX and 0xA11790 the action's actor (the offering giver).

addresses.name: CDistributeLendLease::Distribute
addresses.signature: CFixedPoint* __thiscall CDistributeLendLease::Distribute(CDistributeLendLease* this@ECX, CFixedPoint* out@stack:4, __int64 available@stack:8, bool flag@stack:0x10) @EAX
addresses.comment: **Slot 0: the lend-lease share, read whole 2026-10-13.** total = available * base_percentage (+8) >> 15 * factor (+0x10) >> 15 - a 48.15 IC figure - then for each entry of the country's lend-lease list (+0x6B8): amount = (total * 1000 >> 15, thousandths of IC) * CCountry::GetLendLeaseShare / 1000 * the entry's effectiveness (+0xC) / 1000, each a truncating 64-bit divide. Where amount <= CCountry::GetResourceLimitedIC, CCountry::ConsumeIcResources(amount) charges the giver's metal, energy and rares and CCountry::ReceiveLendLease credits the receiver; **otherwise that receiver gets nothing at all that day**. Writes 0 to out whatever was sent. It reads no define and not CCountry +0x608, so lend-lease received cannot be lent on for free. Index 0 of the six production sliders, _PRODUCTION_LENDLEASE_, the one CCountry::GetAvailableIC leaves out.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x518800..0x51895F: the two 0xB99AF0 multiplies with `shrd 0xF`, the 0x1F40000 (1000 << 15) multiply, the 0xB99980 divides, the compare at 0x5188F0 and the calls 0x4F15C0, 0x4F16D0, 0x508900 with ESI = countries[entry id]; the out written 0 at 0x51894E.

addresses.name: RunCountryDailyPass
addresses.comment: **Everything a country does once a day**, not just politics: 0x4DA530 to the `ret 4` at 0x4DC239 **and cold blocks after it up to 0x4DC404** - corrected 2026-10-13, this said '0x4DC242 onward is SEH unwind, not body': 0x4DC23C..0x4DC24C and 0x4DC3E8..0x4DC3F8 are catch funclets (ReportLuaError, then a continuation address), but 0x4DC24D..0x4DC3E3 is body, reached by `je 0x4DC24F` at 0x4DC15B - the AI's call of BalanceProductionSliders and **BalanceLendLeaseSliders** (0x510160, 0x510210) - and 0x4DC3F9/0x4DC3FF are loop tails jumped to from 0x4DB9A0 and 0x4DA8F9 (trap 3). One caller, RunDailyPass at 0x682E1A, looping the country vector; the address is in no vftable. Phases: three unread helpers, then Neutrality clamped to [0,100000] and EffectiveNeutrality derived; convoys and lend-lease; CCountry::ChangeNeutrality by the NEUTRALITY_CHANGE modifier; the IC block; the daily influence upkeep and then dissent forced to 0 for REB; the underground; elections; surrender; the AI. Alignment drift at 0x4DB87E, every ALIGNMENT_INTERVAL days. See FINDINGS-politics.md for the full ordered table.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x4DC239..0x4DC410 (eleven int3 from 0x4DC405 before the next function); the jumps into the region found by a sweep of every branch target (0x4DC15B je 0x4DC24F, 0x4DB9A0 jns 0x4DC3F9, 0x4DA8F9 jns 0x4DC3FF); the Lua names pushed at 0x510193 and 0x51021F. struct_fields.name: debt
struct_fields.comment: **What the array's owner owes the other country**, thousandths of money - corrected 2026-10-13, this said the other way round. Save key `debt`, token 0x727 (CDiplomacyStatus::LoadKey at 0xA4836E). Grows only while the owner is at war and has allowDebts (+0x78) towards the other: by a licence fee (CLicenceTechnologyAction::Apply, 0xA3C5A1 - the buyer's status towards the seller) and by a trade route's money (CCountry::RunDailyTradeRoutes, 0x4FF442 and 0x4FF485). **Nothing reduces it**: the daily repayment (CCountry::CollectDailyProduction) pays out of it without subtracting, so a debt is repaid for ever.
struct_fields.evidence: Writers by a full .text sweep of `[reg+0x70]` stores whose register came from a `+0xE28` element: the three `add`s only; the licence's debt arm reads the actor's (buyer's) array. Wrong if a writer reached the status another way.

struct_fields.name: daily_repay
struct_fields.comment: How much the owner repays the other a day, thousandths of money. Save key `dailyrepay`, token 0x728. Fixed by CDiplomacyStatus::GetDailyRepay as debt / (YEARS_TO_REPAY_DEBT * 365 days) the first time it is asked with a debt and nothing here; set back to 0 by CCountry::CollectDailyProduction on a day the owner is at war or cannot pay, so it is worked out again from the debt as it then stands.
struct_fields.evidence: Disassembly of 0xA4A7F0 and of the reset at 0x4F25B2.

struct_fields.name: lendlease_distributions
struct_fields.comment: **The countries this one gives lend-lease to**: a vector of 16-byte entries {CCountryTag receiver; int weight (+8); int effectiveness (+0xC)}, end at +0x6BC. Save keys `lendlease_targets` (the tags, loaded with weight 0 and effectiveness 1000), `lendlease_distributions` (the weights) and `lendlease_effectiveness`. weight: the receiver's share is weight / the sum (CCountry::GetLendLeaseShare); a new entry gets 500, CChangeLendLeaseDistributionCommand sets them. effectiveness: thousandths, 1000 over land and the lend-lease convoy's efficiency over sea, set hourly by CCountry::UpdateLendLeaseRoutes; 0 until then.
struct_fields.evidence: CCountry::LoadKey's cases for tokens 2054/2055/2108 (0x4CECF8, 0x4CEDE7, 0x4CEE6D) and the readers and writers named.

struct_fields.name: lend_lease_from_values
struct_fields.comment: **The countries this one receives lend-lease from**: a vector of 12-byte entries {CCountryTag giver; int amount}, end at +0x6CC; save keys `lend_lease_from` (the tags) and `lend_lease_from_values`. amount: thousandths of IC credited by the giver's CDistributeLendLease and not yet turned into IC; CCountry::UpdateIC takes the whole IC out of the entries in order and leaves the fraction.

struct_fields.name: lend_lease_from_yesterday_values
struct_fields.comment: A copy of lend_lease_from_values (+0x6C8) taken by CCountry::UpdateIC before it spends them - what each giver delivered for the day, which the top bar's tooltip shows (0x508A20). 12-byte entries, end at +0x6DC; save keys `lend_lease_from_yesterday` and `_values`.

struct_fields.name: lend_lease_income
struct_fields.comment: Lend-lease received and not yet turned into IC, thousandths of IC: the sum of lend_lease_from_values. CCountry::UpdateIC adds its whole part (/ 1000, truncated) to TotalIC (+0x604) after the resource cap and stores it in lend_lease_ic (+0x608), then subtracts what it used, keeping the fraction for the next day. Save key `lend_lease_income`.
struct_fields.evidence: UpdateIC 0x4F14AC..0x4F14D0 and 0x4F15A5; CCountry::ReceiveLendLease's add at 0x508952; LoadKey token 2114 (0x4CF1ED).

struct_fields.name: lend_lease_income_yesterday
struct_fields.comment: The lend-lease IC a day's CCountry::UpdateIC turned into IC, thousandths (a whole number of IC times 1000), or 0 with no giver. Save key `lend_lease_income_yesterday`.

struct_fields.name: repaid_away
struct_fields.comment: The pool the ledger labels **RES_REPAID_AWAY** (BuildGoodsLedgerTooltip, 0x4F42AF). **Corrected 2026-10-13: it is written** - its money (+0x834) gets each day's debt repayment the country pays, in the repayment loop at the end of CCountry::CollectDailyProduction (0x4F2589); no other good is ever written. The earlier comment's 'no writer outside construction and the daily reset' missed that site; the live zeros it recorded (0 of 108 countries in a 1936 and a 1942 game) fit, because no debt arrangement was in force. Not saved (CCountry::SaveContents writes ten pools, not this one).
struct_fields.evidence: Disassembly 0x4F2589 `add [ebx+0x834], ecx`, ebx the paying country. The SaveContents negative: its pool sequence 0x4CFF1A..0x4D001F (lea ecx,[edi+N] for 0x9F8, 0x770, 0x98C, 0x9B0, 0x9D4, 0x7B8, 0x86C, 0x890, 0x7DC, 0x800).

struct_fields.name: income_from_debt
struct_fields.comment: The pool the ledger labels **RES_INC_DEBT** (0x4F396C), and part of CCountry::GetDailyIncome. **Corrected 2026-10-13: it is written** - its money (+0x858) gets each day's debt repayment the country receives, in CCountry::CollectDailyProduction (0x4F258F); no other good. The live zeros recorded earlier fit, because no debt arrangement was in force. Not saved.

struct_fields.name: lend_lease_partner
struct_fields.comment: The tag and id CCountry::CreateConvoy is handed for a lend-lease convoy, `---` and 0 for any other. **It names the giver**: a lend-lease convoy belongs to the receiver, runs from the giver's harbour to the receiver's, and is made, kept and scrapped by CCountry::UpdateLendLeaseRoutes, which finds it by is_lend_lease (+0xA1) and this id (+0xA8). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplyconvoys.md, section 6.
struct_fields.evidence: CCountry::UpdateLendLeaseRoutes's CreateConvoy call (receiver as the country, the giver's tag and id as the last two arguments) and its search (`[conv+0xA1]`, `[conv+0xA8] == giver id`); CCountry::RemoveLendLeaseSource the same.

struct_fields.name: is_theory
struct_fields.comment: Set on a theory, clear on a practical. Only a theory can be shared (CShareTechnologyAction::IsValid, CShareTechnologyDialog::BuildCategoryList, CCountry::CheckTechSharing); ApplyTechCategoryDecay picks theories or practicals by it.
struct_fields.evidence: The four readers named; ApplyTechCategoryDecay's comment already reads +0x60 == 0 as a practical. Wrong if a practical were ever shared - the share dialog would list it.
